$comment: HorneroOS factory defaults: a fresh boot (or a fresh --dest materialize) lands on Hornero Dark with no user setup and no network fetch. All values here are static files in this repo; nothing is cloned from ulises-jeremias/dotfiles at runtime (that repo is a read-only extraction source, see docs/DECISIONS.md).

compositor.note: Curated Hornero Dark borders/groups; shadow tint in hyprland.conf decoration block.

integrations.name: Kitty
integrations.detail: GPU-accelerated, with the Kitty graphics protocol used by Yazi previews.
integrations.note: A static Hornero Dark or Light palette keeps the terminal readable before the first generated scheme.

integrations.name: Alacritty
integrations.detail: A compact TOML configuration with live reload; Yazi image previews use the Wayland adapter through Überzug++ where configured.
integrations.note: The packaged dark/light fallback and generated color file are imported separately, so wallpaper colors can update without replacing your base config.

integrations.name: Ghostty
integrations.detail: A native Ghostty theme with a stable name that Hornero can refresh when appearance changes.
integrations.note: A packaged system fallback is available before Hornero writes the user-level wallpaper palette.

terminal.note: Kitty is the Exo/default terminal. Alacritty and Ghostty are optional curated configurations; wallpaper-derived M3 colors render to each app's native format.

paletteApplications.name: btop
paletteApplications.detail: A native btop theme generated from the active Hornero wallpaper palette.
paletteApplications.note: btop remains an optional application; Hornero Config provides its defaults and theme when installed.

paletteApplications.name: Cava
paletteApplications.detail: A native Cava theme generated from the active Hornero wallpaper palette.
paletteApplications.note: Cava remains an optional application; Hornero Config provides its defaults and theme when installed.

gtk.note: Applied by the config-gtk worker via desktop/gtk/settings.ini; recorded here so fresh-boot-dark is one contract.

fonts.note: Material Symbols ships the shell icon font declared in shell/shell.default.json (appearance.font.family.material). Sans/mono families are recorded from shell/shell.default.json; their Arch packaging is AUR-side and documented in docs/FACTORY_DEFAULTS.md.

wallpaper.note: Procedural SVG source is rendered at package staging; the theme applies the raster at /usr/share/hornero/wallpapers/hornero-dark/hornero-dark-01.png.
